notes.title: Treasure Hunters - 10 Different themes & 10 New Artifact Rooms
notes.content: [p]Greetings Dear Adventurers,[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Dungeon Themes:[/b][/h3][p]You might remember that i mentioned that I implemented a dungeon theme system. This week I created [b]10[/b] different themes for the [b]10[/b] dungeons avaiable in the game. Here are some of them (I'm too lazy to upload all of them but i think you get the idea):[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600505/e879ed77cf00ff1e578f2714c27c812b2c831532.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600505/28c8eaf4f2f06bd38c9d4c9b1b20117e618db8c6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600505/979ea6f824eb942604b332953422ed4ed79746f4.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Artifact Rooms:[/b][/h3][p]I also created [b]10[/b] different main artifact rooms. These rooms will have their [b]own[/b] mechanics, traps and lore etc. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600505/8500a73493d2d345440f469082c143cf1abfbef3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600505/458319cb4dce66c2e89fb4aeb2d05edb1f6c6f6f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600505/e396872bd192472dcc35390b89cebde4514ba1a5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Optimization:[/b][/p][p]I also worked on optimizing the textures to reduce the VRAM usage.  [/p][p]Obviously also some bug fixes.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]CLOSED BETA:[/b][/h3][p]I'll be joining a gamejam next 3-4 days so I won't be working on the game. But after the jam I'm planning to work on the artifact mechanics. Which means, some artifacts will have their own mechanics to make the player have a hard time carry them back to the truck. [/p][p]And I'll be opening closed beta tests from the people in discord soon (I'll announce in the discord). So that I can balance the game more efficiently. You can join the discord here if you'd like to join the beta test:  [url="https://discord.gg/vbmhbQJqRW"]https://discord.gg/vbmhbQJqRW[/url][/p][p][/p][h3][b]And lastly, of couse don't forget to wishlist the full game:[/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2835460/Treasure_Hunters/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Treasure Hunters - Dungeon Themes, Emotes & Network optimization
notes.content: [p]Hello Dear Adventurers,[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Emotes:[/b][/h3][p]This week, I implemented a emote system and added 8 of them. Incase you get the references let me know when the game comes out.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889558/3f59a59d4b95e3fb80024b2895323b41d96dd970.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Dungeon Themes:[/b][/h3][p]Someone gave a bad review to the Prologue, saying "both 2 dungeons look the same" and I couldn't agree more. So I implemented a theme system, every dungeon will have their own theme based on their lore. Yes I also finished the lores of the all dungeons.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889558/12d422c9d2d3caf836a0847ecfe031c63996768c.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Network Optimization:[/b][/h3][p]The main reason dungeon wall sometimes not spawning on the clients were because of the high bandwith requirement. With the optimizations I lowered it greatly. [/p][p][/p][p]I've got an exam this week and I'm finally graduating from my annoying ass school but until next week I'll be working on finishing the all dungeon themes, optimizing and data save.[/p][p][/p][p]Until next time, keep hunting ːIndyː[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Don't forget to wishlist :[/b][/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2835460/Treasure_Hunters/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Treasure Hunters - New Hall Events & 10 Dungeons
notes.content: [p]Hello Dear Adventurers,[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Hallway Events:[/b][/h3][p]In this update, I mostly worked on the hallways. There used to be around 7-8 hallway events in the prologue; now there's around 20 - 25, and I'm planning to make more later. I don't want to mention what kind of things I added because I want you to be surprised by them while playing the full game. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600505/cb3a59c90bc5512f6ca56247ea3583cf90b55600.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]All 10 Dungeons:[/b][/h3][p]I implemented every dungeon in the game, their enemies, artifacts etc. Still haven't written their lores but I will do that soon. (The names are just placeholders)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600505/71f182829b112efafdfff9a14e5cf7703cd6a556.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]PlayFab analytics:[/b][/h3][p]I implemented an analytics system so that I can watch you anytime. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600505/9c87d50be8a3c296d80db6d963a083b11ffad585.gif"][/img][/p][p]And of course, analyze the XPs, levels, difficulty of dungeons, duration, etc. So that I can balance the game. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Features:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Enemies can be stunned [/p][/*][*][p]Spider will be stunned if you hold a flashlight while it is crawling on the ceiling[/p][/*][*][p]Dungeon unlocking system[/p][/*][*][p]Item balances[/p][/*][*][p]Synchronizations of the traps and moving platforms[/p][/*][*][p]Shining effect on treasure[/p][/*][*][p]Stun effect when a player or enemy is stunned[/p][/*][*][p]Much more sensible dungeon collapsing time[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Dungeon Walls not loading (not sure if it is fixed, I'll test it very carefully)[/p][/*][*][p]Pots disappear when they are picked up[/p][/*][*][p]Bridge being build bug [/p][/*][*][p]Coop rooms spawns for singleplayer[/p][/*][*][p]Whip weird visual bug[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3] [b]Also don't forget to wishlist the full game![/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2835460/Treasure_Hunters/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Treasure Hunters - Rat Swarm Enemy & New Tools
notes.content: [p]Hello Dear Adventurers, [/p][p]This week I worked on a new freaky ah enemy and added a couple of new tools to use. I hope you like it.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]RATS:[/b][/h3][p]I was inspired by Plague Tale while making this enemy. Every single rat has really low hp but you can hit one at a time. So kicking, shooting with pistol etc. might not work on them. You will need to find another way.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600505/977eb62c6e768b5bfc34633df48ccbfb518d1c0e.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]NEW ITEMS:[/b][/h3][p][b]Dynamite: F*CKING KABOOM! [/b]You can blow up things. Even that stony ass mf creeping through the dungeon. And if you are too lazy to solve the puzzle, just make the door non existent ;)[/p][p][b]Insect Repeller: [/b]Keeps the insects (ants, mosquitos, spiders) away until the battery is ran out.[/p][p][b]Map creator:[/b] Creates the layout of the dungeon while the owner is roaming around. So you can now know where you were headed, and find your back to truck easily.[/p][p][b]Shotgun:[/b] Well, it's a shotgun. It's the 3rd tier of the weapons.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600505/6268c7161d3881d09e93a110e51c3f464e21ed3c.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]New Features:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Tier 2,3 HEAL ITEMS CAN REVIVE OTHER PLAYERS[/p][/*][*][p]You can now attack with torch[/p][/*][*][p]Bullets have a delay for reaching the destination after they are shot[/p][/*][*][p]Created the implementation of adding the new dungeons[/p][/*][*][p]Moving objects new implementation (synced)[/p][/*][*][p]Menu singleplayer part[/p][/*][*][p]Spectator speed increased[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bugs Fixed:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Very little treasure is spawned[/p][/*][*][p]If you leave co-op pads the doors close back again now[/p][/*][*][p]Taking torch bug is fixed[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Treasure Hunters - New Lobby
notes.content: [p]Hello Dear Adventurers, [/p][p][/p][p]After many feedbacks and requests I finally implemented a new 3D lobby in the game. The lobby is consist of 2 rooms. Hope you like it![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Headquarter room:[/b][/h3][p]In this room you'll be able to manage your equipment, change the contract, invite friends and start the adventure. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600505/e458d146a6a249640a565423f74131c471183b61.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Showcase Room:[/b][/h3][p]In the showcase room you'll be able to see the objective artifacts you've returned so far. Also has a huge free space to spam run slide. ːsansː [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600505/f02386c91a69dc1a71f2d69340213a11582287bd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I also added a [b]playable[/b] piano in the headquarters room. If you have any classical piano music requests you can write it down in the comments and I'll add them. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600505/767699eea2efbdb8be3eac5bcceb70ce0632ecf0.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Also please don't forget to wishlist the full game:[/b][/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2835460/Treasure_Hunters/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Treasure Hunters - New Playable Character & New Enemy
notes.content: [p]Hello Dear Adventurers,[/p][p][/p][p]I've been working on a new character and a new enemy since the last update and of course some fixes. This update and the future ones won't be included in the prologue version (I might do some fixes for prologue not sure)[/p][p]Though we are finally saying goodbye to our dear friend "the guy" (he didn't even have a name) that we played with for a long time. [/p][p]Waiting for your "RIP"s in the comment ːcsgo_despairːːsteamsadː[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600505/f14dedc815b900fb38e961a3549a57ff3b540157.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Metahuman Character:[/b][/h3][p]I created a new playable character with Unreal Engine's metahuman creator. What so exciting about this update is that this character is fully modular. So every part (hands, head, clothes etc.) are seperate. And with this implementation, we can have a character customization in the future ;)[/p][p]And I have a favor to ask, what should we name this character? I'm planning to go with "Adam" at the moment. Please let me know in the comments.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600505/b2c1afe1c1a07e57aa87cda94a3aca12c34af936.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Tzitzimitl:[/b][/h3][p]Tzitzimitl is a demon from Aztec Mythology and our new character for Treasure Hunters. I won't spoil her ability but believe me it will be cool. Just know that she hates artificial lights, so your flashlight might come in handy against her...[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600505/b176b185e48a8539a1a526ce7d09d93f9e5609f3.png"][/img][/p][p]For the next update I'm working on a new 3D lobby. And will post about it soon. Until then take care and keep hunting![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Also don't forget to wishlist the full game on Steam:[/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2835460/Treasure_Hunters/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Treasure Hunters: Prologue - v1.2 Update
notes.content: [p]Hello Dear Adventurers,[/p][p][/p][p]In this update, I mostly reworked everything related to clients. Most of the objects used to work server side so clients used to wait for a bit of time to get a feedback from anything. With this update most of the gears, items, mechanics etc. works client sided. So clients will get an instant feedback even if they have very high pings. Here are the changes I made in this update:[/p][p][/p][p][b]FEATURES:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Added a more clear tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Ranged Enemies will miss by chance if is lightened by a flashlight (for example, you can point a flashlight at a mosquito to miss when they shoot)[/p][/*][*][p]Random treasures spawn system by specified rarity[/p][/*][*][p]Lever has two notifications for cooldown and for stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]Inspectable Paper better rotation (F*CKING FINALLY)[/p][/*][*][p]High Ping Warning for clients[/p][/*][*][p]Players spawn blood particles when get damaged[/p][/*][*][p]Less report noise call from footsteps[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes on enemies' hearing settings[/p][/*][*][p]Now the overall treasure value for a dungeon is multiplied by the DungeonGrowth OverallTreasureValue * (TileAmount/ExpectedTileAmount)[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]CLIENT SIDED REWORKS:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Hit Feedback Client side[/p][/*][*][p]InspectableItems are now client sided[/p][/*][*][p]Yohu's Heart is client sided (Full release)[/p][/*][*][p]Artifact Holder picking up is client sided [/p][/*][*][p]Door Opening Effects are client sided [/p][/*][*][p]Coffin opening is client sided [/p][/*][*][p]Halucination Objects are now Works client sided[/p][/*][*][p]Incenses Work client sided[/p][/*][*][p]Openable secret chambers now work client sided[/p][/*][*][p]Drain now Works client sided (Full release)[/p][/*][*][p]Glowing Button now Works client sided (Full release)[/p][/*][*][p]Holdable Valve now works client sided (Full release)[/p][/*][*][p]Pickupable objects disappears immedieately for clients before spawning in their hand. (Faster Feedback)[/p][/*][*][p]Blowing Dart only works for client bug is fixed (Full release)[/p][/*][*][p]Flashlight now works client sided [/p][/*][*][p]Rarity Detector turkish characters are missing[/p][/*][*][p]Rarity Detector now works client sided[/p][/*][*][p]Dropping Objects are now client sided (faster feedback right after pressing G)[/p][/*][*][p]Gun hitbacks are now client sided.[/p][/*][*][p]Switching Items now works on client side[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]BUG FIXES:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Main artifact doesnt count at the end bug is fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Removed "Change mesh" object from game[/p][/*][*][p]Pushing a player without kicking them bug is fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies interact with keys bug is fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Sack can duplicate items bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Friends button doesnt work after a friend join bug is fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Spectator ui text fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Weird animation while picking up animation while crouching is fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Picking up animation on client doesnt work[/p][/*][*][p]While crouching and sliding, not falling of edges bug is fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed seeing head while swimming[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed flame traps not working sometimes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed moving logs in DeathRun room (in full release)[/p][/*][*][p]Mirrors turning slower on low fps bug is fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Internet connection pop up, bux is fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Squeezer trap going through the wall bug[/p][/*][*][p]Weird gates in lava pit room is fixed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That was a busy ass week, and it will be even busier for the next couple of weeks, but I'm dedicated to bringing your dream Co-op Indy game to reality. [/p][p][/p][p]Please don't forget to leave a review on Steam, give feedback [/p][h3][b]AND DON'T FORGET TO WISHLIST THE FULL GAME:[/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2835460/Treasure_Hunters/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Treasure Hunters: Prologue - Hotfix 3
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone, again thanks to your feedback I was able to fix some major and minor bugs. And here are some of them. Also the voice chat works properly now. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Newly Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased pistol range[/p][/*][*][p]Increased fire rest duration on flame traps[/p][/*][*][p]Added microphone threshold[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Symbol rocks used to collide with player and disappear now they don't (thanks to [b]rhavegn and[/b] [b][u]龍龍uwu[/u][/b] in discord)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed spikes on the walls going through each other[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed input devices duplication[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed input device changing every time opening the options screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pressure pads inside the spike ceiling room, causing players to be stuck out[/p][/*][*][p]Inspectable papers used to push pickup items and pickups would disappear, now they don't[/p][/*][*][p]Added a collision at the back of the pickup[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed, moving stone disappears which is going up in a coop light puzzle room [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dungeon generator removes the last room at the beginning[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you so much for helping me improving the game, you can DM whenever you want on discord in case you encounter a bug. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Also please remember to wishlist the full game[/b][/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2835460/Treasure_Hunters/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Treasure Hunters: Prologue - v1.1 Update
notes.content: [p]Hello Dear Adventurers, [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks all of you for your feedbacks. They are helping me update the game much much faster. In this update I added some little helpful features and fixed some major bugs. [/p][h3][b]Features:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added Information Popups[/p][/*][*][p]Added loading screen right after pressing Start Game[/p][/*][*][p]Added change icon on map selector[/p][/*][*][p]NOW YOU CAN CLOSE OPTIONS MENU WITH PRESSING ESC!![/p][/*][*][p]Increased the default graphic options[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed 4 people can’t join bug (Thanks to [b]asd4916134,  [/b]their friends[b] [/b]for reporting this bug)[/p][/*][*][p]Squeezing Wall not synched bug is  fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Objects fallingthrough terrain is “mostly” fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rarity detector’s characters[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed doors are showing up on in rooms with no exit (for clients)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed keys spawning on rooms with no doors[/p][/*][*][p]You can jump onto these shelves and clip through the tent[/p][/*][*][p]Flickering textures in spike ceiling room[/p][/*][*][p]Picking up the artifact without switching bug is fixed[/p][/*][/list][p]Again thanks to all of you and don't forget, keep hunting.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]And remember to add the full game to your wishlist[/b][/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2835460/Treasure_Hunters/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
